dataset.title: An Open Insole-Based Plantar Pressure Dataset at Varying Cadences Compared Against GAITRite
dataset.condition: NP: self-selected normal-pace walking; a source experimental condition, not a normative clinical category.
dataset.timeBasis: frame index is zero-based. t=index/64 seconds is nominal relative time reconstructed from the stated acquisition rate. The CSV contains no timestamps; L and R are not asserted absolutely synchronized here.

units.values: unconverted source channel values; physical pressure units not documented in the selected release materials
units.cop: source insole drawing coordinates; physical length scale unverified
units.sum: sum of 32 unconverted channel values; not newtons

dataset.sensorGeometry: 32 spatially separated source channels, not a dense measured pressure grid. Interpolated displays must be labelled as visualization.
dataset.calibration: Source repository explicitly reports no subject-specific calibration. No conversion to kPa, N, mm or cm is applied.
dataset.synchronization: Source sync_auto.json is retained as evidence only. No offset correction, resampling, world-frame transformation or bilateral resultant CoP is applied.
dataset.contactLabels: No contact labels are supplied. Source CoP exists even at low sums. An adjustable teaching analysis mask may hide these samples; it does not establish physical foot contact.
dataset.scope: Public research example from a different instrumented-insole study. It is not LTM-ZDYL-200 output, an individual prediction, a diagnostic reference or clinical validation.
changes: Selected one normal-pace clip, P1/NP/1, with two 249-frame side files.
Kept the 32 source channel values, original copX/copY and original sumP unchanged. IMU channels remain in source CSV but are omitted from this teaching JSON.
Reconstructed the coordinate system used by exported CoP from the public source values and CoP relationship; checked channel numbering/layout against the released SVGs.

Added zero-based indices, provenance, nominal-rate explanation and teaching analysis suggestions. No pressure baseline subtraction, filtering, smoothing, contact-event inference or amplitude normalization was applied.

coordinateProvenance.method: Recovered the 32 drawing coordinates in the source export relation [values] @ [coordinates] = [sumP] * [copX,copY] using all 249 source frames. The system is full-rank (32); solutions match half-unit source coordinates within 4e-11.
coordinateProvenance.svgCheck: All 32 channel numbers map uniquely to 32 circular source pads. Drawing layout agrees under a fitted affine display transform, with a maximum residual below 5 SVG units. This is an illustrative layout cross-check, not physical registration.
coordinateProvenance.internalSvgNaming: Published SVG docname/desc retain opposite-side legacy names. The Zenodo filename, per-channel numbering and source export relationship are preserved as the side evidence; no file is silently renamed or mirrored by this module.

ZIP central directory represented as a JSON file list; no archive content beyond the selected members is bundled.

teachingAnalysis.thresholdDefinition: Include a frame when sumP >= selectedRatio * maximum(sumP) within the same side and this clip. This is an explicit teaching filter, not an instrument contact threshold.
teachingAnalysis.rationale: The source sample has low nonzero background sums around 1000 and larger sums around 20000–29000. A 15% within-side peak threshold makes the impact of including/excluding low-sum coordinates visible. Keep it adjustable, report the chosen value, and break the visible path across excluded frames.
teachingAnalysis.sideComparison: Do not interpret uncalibrated channel or sum differences as measured left/right force imbalance.
